name: agent-electron
title: Agent Electron
description: Use when controlling cicy-desktop Electron BrowserWindows, sandbox sessions, CDP targets, or host-side Electron injection scripts through desktop_event RPC.
author: cicy-ai

zh-CN.title: Agent Electron
zh-CN.description: 驱动 cicy-desktop 的 Electron BrowserWindow 和 per-account session。accountIdx = profile id = session id，并映射到 sandbox-N partition；session 下所有 window 共享代理。

tools.name: sessions
tools.description: List sandbox sessions, grouped by accountIdx (each = persist:sandbox-N)

tools.name: session
tools.description: Show the windows + partition + proxy of one session (accountIdx)

tools.name: profiles
tools.description: List configured Electron profiles; accountIdx, profile id, and session id are the same numeric identifier

tools.name: tabs
tools.description: List BrowserView tabs and their webContentsId for one accountIdx

tools.name: webcontents
tools.description: Return an array of every live WebContents; each item includes webContentsId, url, and profileId

tools.name: proxy
tools.description: Set the upstream proxy on a session — applies to every window opened under that accountIdx

tools.name: open
tools.description: Open <url> in a BrowserWindow (--idx selects the session, default 1). Check windows first: if the URL is already open, win.show()/focus() it and report its winId; --no-reuse forces a fresh window

tools.name: close
tools.description: Close a BrowserWindow by winId or a BrowserView tab by webContentsId

tools.name: windows
tools.description: List all live Electron BrowserWindows on the host

tools.name: window
tools.description: Show one BrowserWindow or BrowserView tab's details

tools.name: url
tools.description: Load a new URL in an existing BrowserWindow or BrowserView tab

tools.name: cdp
tools.description: Send a raw Chrome DevTools Protocol command to a BrowserWindow or BrowserView tab

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot a window or BrowserView tab (clipboard by default, --out for file). Only with explicit user permission

tools.name: snapshot
tools.description: Capture a DOM snapshot of a BrowserWindow or BrowserView tab — the default way to inspect page state

tools.name: sysinfo
tools.description: Host system info (platform, electron/chrome versions, screens)

tools.name: inject
tools.description: Install, inspect, or uninstall a JavaScript file in the Desktop host's fixed Electron injection directory
